products.description:
WILSON BLADE V4 2026 - The new Blade arrives renewed, with a slight design change and with improved technologies to achieve a more balanced and durable racket. Without a doubt, one of the Wilson rackets with the best quality-price ratio. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The WILSON BLADE V4 2026 arrives completely renewed to continue being one of the brand's most balanced padel rackets. Its teardrop format helps us achieve that balance so desired by players.

It is a racket that transmits a lot of confidence both from the back of the court and in the net game.

PLAYER TYPE

Designed for players looking for an excellent compromise between control, power and comfort, it offers a very versatile behavior that adapts to any match situation.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The materials in the WILSON BLADE V4 2026 are quality. We find a combination of carbon fiber and fiberglass. With this duo, a balanced, flexible feel and good durability are achieved.

Its rubber is firm Foam, a hard and stable rubber that increases the power in our blows, but also leaving us with the characteristic softness of foam rubber.

Its technologies are: a rough surface Spin Effect Texture, which facilitates the generation of effects. Its C2 Tubular Construction structure, made entirely of carbon. In addition, the Anti-Fragile Edge protector reinforces the frame against bumps and scratches, while the Duo Grid Hole system optimizes the performance of the hitting surface.

products.title: Dunlop Galactica Pro - Dunlop
products.description:
DUNLOP GALACTICA PRO – es la pala que empuñará el mítico Juani Mieres en el World Pádel Tour.

 INTRODUCCION DE LA PALA

La Dunlop Galactica pro es una pala fabricada íntegramente en carbono y tope de gama de la prestigiosa firma Dunlop Pádel, ideal para aquellos jugadores que quiera una pala polivalente y de gran calidad.

TIPO DE JUGADOR

Está indicada para jugadores que busquen polivalencia en el juego y quieran defender con comodidad, pero a la hora de realizar golpes de definición sea una pala que les cumpla con creces.

CARACTERISTICAS DE LA PALA

La Dunlop Galactica Pro es una pala con formato de lágrima y está fabricada con carbono 12k en el plano y tubular de carbono para una mayor durabilidad. Este año la nueva Galáctica incorpora una tecnología llamada 45º fase que introduce un extra de carbono en la cara para una mayor durabilidad y rigidez en el golpeo.

 

En el corazón de la pala encontramos un antivibrador para reducir esas vibraciones tan incomodas en el brazo que pueden producir lesiones, lo que es un aspecto muy positivo a tener en cuenta, esta tecnología la llama Dunlop TRIMAX.

 

El peso de este modelo de Dunlop pádel es de 370 gramos y presenta un balance alto para tener una mayor potencia en el golpe de definición.

 

Otra de las tecnologías utilizadas es el protector INJECTION BUMPER, que protege el marco en lances del juego no deseados.

 

Y por último hablamos de la tecnología CONTROL HOLES, con la que se consigue un taladro homogéneo en la cara de la pala con la misma distancia entre agujeros para que la raqueta sea lo más estable posible.

 

DISEÑO DE LA PALA

El diseño de esta DUNLOP GALACTICA PRO es minimalista, ya que presenta un color negro en toda la pala con un difuminado en blanco, para hacerla una de las palas de pádel más sobrias y elegantes del mercado.

ESTILO DE JUEGO

Esta DUNLOP GALACTICA PRO es ideal para aquellos jugadores que les guste pegar fuerte a la pelota, pero a la hora de defender tengan las garantías suficientes para llegar hasta la red de nuevo.
products.englishTitle: Dunlop Galactica Pro - Dunlop
products.englishDescription:
DUNLOP GALACTICA PRO – is the racket that the legendary Juani Mieres will wield in the World Pádel Tour.

 INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The Dunlop Galactica pro is a racket made entirely of carbon and top of the range from the prestigious Dunlop Pádel brand, ideal for those players who want a versatile and high-quality racket.

PLAYER TYPE

It is indicated for players who seek versatility in the game and want to defend comfortably, but when it comes to making finishing hits, it is a racket that more than meets their needs.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The Dunlop Galactica Pro is a teardrop-shaped racket and is made with 12k carbon in the plane and carbon tubular for greater durability. This year the new Galactica incorporates a technology called 45º phase that introduces extra carbon in the face for greater durability and rigidity when hitting.

 

At the heart of the racket we find an anti-vibrator to reduce those uncomfortable vibrations in the arm that can cause injuries, which is a very positive aspect to take into account, this technology is called Dunlop TRIMAX.

 

The weight of this Dunlop padel model is 370 grams and has a high balance to have greater power in the finishing blow.

 

Another of the technologies used is the INJECTION BUMPER protector, which protects the frame in unwanted game sets.

 

And finally we talk about the CONTROL HOLES technology, with which a homogeneous hole is achieved on the face of the racket with the same distance between holes so that the racket is as stable as possible.

 

BLADE DESIGN

The design of this DUNLOP GALACTICA PRO is minimalist, as it presents a black color throughout the racket with a white blur, to make it one of the most sober and elegant padel rackets on the market.

PLAY STYLE

This DUNLOP GALACTICA PRO is ideal for those players who like to hit the ball hard, but when it comes to defending they have enough guarantees to reach the net again.

products.title: Head Extreme One - Head
products.description:
HEAD EXTREME ONE - The padel revolution comes with this one-hole racket. The new Extreme One comes to delight the most daring players.

 INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

Officially presented by Head Padel and within the Head racket collection, the HEAD EXTREME ONE will undoubtedly be the revolution racket of the coming seasons. As its main feature, we see that it has a single hole and this will give us incredible durability on the court, greatly reducing the risk of flat breakage.

PLAYER TYPE

This Head single-hole padel racket is the jewel of the Extreme collection, designed for players who seek exceptional performance on the court and want to be unique. Light as a feather, this diamond-shaped racket is the perfect choice for both advanced and professional players.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

Do you want to fully understand the most revolutionary padel racket on the market?

The HEAD EXTREME ONE is unique, as you only have to look at its composition without perforation, with only a single hole in the lower area, which perfectly complies with the FIP regulations.

Weighing approximately 345 grams, the Extreme One is the lightest racket in Head's Extreme collection. This low weight will give us total mobility of the racket, being able to excel in both defensive and offensive hits.

The cloth of this racket is made with 12K carbon fiber, which can be perfectly seen on the entire surface, accompanied by Extreme Spin technology that adds the rough touch more than necessary for extra control and effect in our shots.

The Auxetic technology could not be missing, which adds an additional dimension to your game by providing an optimized response to each shot. If the ball comes fast, this system contracts and generates more power, and if it comes slow, it expands for greater control. Without a doubt a unique technology available to Head.

PLAY STYLE

The HEAD EXTREME ONE is a padel racket that will stand out above all for its enormous power. By having a single hole, the racket achieves a firmer and more powerful touch since the ball is less in contact with the plane. The control is not bad either, since it has been manufactured in a low weight to be able to dominate it in defensive blows.
